metadata.description: Open collection of agent skills for Claude and other LLM agents

plugins.name: wikipedia-article
plugins.description: Write Wikipedia articles at the highest encyclopedic standard, in your own writing style: assess notability, find sources, draft under mentor guard, audit via a devil's-advocate review, then polish. Add new content or events via a weight gate. Enforces Wikipedia's core policies and the LLM-use boundaries — AI output stays private working material, nothing machine-written is published. Methods: style, assess, sources, add, draft, audit, revise, polish, walkthrough.

plugins.name: vermenschlichen
plugins.description: German writing rules that avoid the typical tells of AI-generated text. Companion to wikipedia-article; lives in its own repo and is listed here for one-stop installs.
